verses.tithi: Śukla Pakṣa Daśamī (until 8:45 PM EDT) → Ekādaśī — Kansa Vadh (the day Kṛṣṇa killed Kaṁsa, the tyrant's fall)
verses.nakshatra: Pūrva Bhādrapadā (until 8:26 PM EDT) — the former auspicious feet, the fire that burns; then Uttara Bhādrapadā — the latter auspicious feet, the water that cools
verses.yoga: Harṣaṇa (until 8:09 PM EDT) — joy, delight; then Vajra — the thunderbolt, the diamond, the indestructible
sankhyaConcepts: Thursday as Guru-day — the Guru removes the false ruler (Kaṁsa) from the heart
Saṅga (attachment) as rāga binding puruṣa to prakṛti; phala as karma-phala binding to rebirth
Saṅgaṁ tyaktvā is surgical removal of rāga; phalāni ca tyaktvā removes dveṣa
Guru (Jupiter) is the heavy one who weighs and removes; Kansa Vadh is the false ruler's fall
Verse is Guru's final instruction: saṅgaṁ tyaktvā phalāni ca kartavyānīti

verses.tithi: Śukla Pakṣa Pañcamī (until 12:54 PM EDT) → Ṣaṣṭhī — Labh Pañcamī (the merchant's new ledger day)
verses.nakshatra: Pūrvāṣāḍhā (until 9:54 AM EDT) — the former invincible; then Uttarāṣāḍhā — the latter invincible
verses.yoga: Śūla (until 7:52 PM EDT) — the spear; then Gāṇḍa — the knot
sankhyaConcepts: Saturday as Śani-day — the planet that enforces the boundary between puruṣa and prakṛti
Threefold tyāga matching three guṇas: sāttvika, rājasika, tāmasika
Niścaya as viveka-khyāti (discriminative discernment) enforced by Saturn
Pūrvāṣāḍhā→Uttarāṣāḍhā: first victory yields to final victory

verses.tithi: Śukla Pakṣa Navamī (until 8:36 PM EDT) → Daśamī — Akṣaya Navamī (the inexhaustible ninth)
verses.nakshatra: Śatabhiṣā (until 7:40 PM EDT) — the hundred physicians; then Pūrva Bhādrapadā — the fire that burns impurity
verses.yoga: Vyāghāta (until 9:12 PM EDT) — the tiger's strike; then Harṣaṇa — joy
sankhyaConcepts: Wednesday as Budha-day — discrimination (buddhi) discerns the three purifiers
Yajña, dāna, tapaḥ as the threefold kriyā-yoga (tapas, svādhyāya, īśvara-praṇidhāna)
Manīṣiṇām (the wise) are not exempt from purification
Akṣaya Navamī: the three purifiers are akṣaya (inexhaustible, self-renewing)

verses.tithi: Śukla Pakṣa Aṣṭamī (until 7:35 PM EDT) → Navamī — Gopāṣṭamī (cow worship, sustainers of yajña)
verses.nakshatra: Dhaniṣṭhā (until 6:04 PM EDT) — the wealthiest, Vasus; then Śatabhiṣā — the hundred physicians, healing
verses.yoga: Dhruva (until 9:35 PM EDT) — the fixed point, pole star; then Vyāghāta — the tiger's strike
sankhyaConcepts: Tuesday as Maṅgala-day — action cuts the false binary
Kāma as rājasic fruitive mode vs yajña as sāttvic action
Dhruva→Vyāghāta: fixed puruṣa watches prakṛti strike
Gopāṣṭamī — cows as sustainers of yajña, not objects

verses.tithi: Śukla Pakṣa Ṣaṣṭhī (until 3:31 PM EDT) → Saptamī — Skanda Ṣaṣṭhī (Lord Kārtikeya's day, commander of the divine host)
verses.nakshatra: Uttarāṣāḍhā (until 12:58 PM EDT) — the latter invincible one, Viśvedevas; then Śravaṇa — hearing, the ear of the Veda
verses.yoga: Gāṇḍa (until 8:45 PM EDT) — the knot, the obstruction; then Vṛddhi — growth, expansion
sankhyaConcepts: Sunday as Sūrya-day — revelation of the distinction between sannyāsa and tyāga
Kāma as rāga in fruitive mode — attachment to fruit
Sannyāsa as surgical removal of rāga; tyāga as dissolution of dveṣa
Gāṇḍa→Vṛddhi: the knot untying into expansion (tamas→rajas→sattva)

verses.tithi: Śukla Pakṣa Saptamī (until 5:49 PM EDT) → Aṣṭamī — the 7th→8th waxing phase, the mind approaching half-full
verses.nakshatra: Śravaṇa (until 3:46 PM EDT) — hearing, the ear of the Veda; then Dhaniṣṭhā — the drum, the rhythm of wealth
verses.yoga: Vṛddhi (until 9:23 PM EDT) — growth, expansion; then Dhruva — the fixed point, the pole star
sankhyaConcepts: Monday as manas-day — mind-stuff oscillating, receiving, reflecting
Arjuna's question as citta-vṛtti (doubt) seeking tattva (principle)
Vṛścika Saṅkrānti as alchemical fire transforming false identity
Śravaṇa→Dhaniṣṭhā: hearing becomes the beat that acts
Vṛddhi→Dhruva: expansion settles into the immovable point (pole star)

verses.tithi: Śukla Pakṣa Chaturdaśī (4:07 AM EDT – 2:26 AM EDT Oct 25) — Eve of Śarad Pūrṇimā, moon at 15/16 kalās
verses.nakshatra: Uttara Bhādrapada (until 11:02 AM EDT), then Revatī (gandamool)
sankhyaConcepts: Tapas as prakṛti's own purification process — the guṇas settling toward sattva
Purity not added but revealed: what remains when the dross burns (aśuddhi-kṣayāt tapasaḥ)
Daivī sampad as the soul's pūrṇatā — fullness; the moon's sixteen kalās as diagram
Abhayaṁ as the first divine wealth — the counter to Śani's manufactured fear

verses.tithi: Śukla Pakṣa Daśamī (until 4:42 AM EDT Oct 21) — Vijayadaśamī / Dussehra
sankhyaConcepts: Twofold creation: daivī (sattvic buddhi) vs āsurī (tamasic/rajasic distortion)
Liberation (vimokṣa) through discriminative discernment (viveka-khyāti)
Kriyā-yoga (tapas-svādhyāya-īśvara-praṇidhāna) as operational daivī sampad
Abhijātaḥ — birth-verified divine nature; puruṣa's cryptographic signature

verses.tithi: Ashvina Śukla Pakṣa Navami (until 3:20 AM EDT Oct 20) — Saraswati Visarjan / Maha Navami
sankhyaConcepts: Āsurī nature as ajñāna — inability to distinguish pravṛtti from nivṛtti
Kleśa-āvaraṇa: obstacles remaining (saṅkleśa) obscure discriminative intellect (buddhi)
Ganda yoga as the knot of kleshas binding the sādhaka
Vairāgya (detachment) as the removal of obstacles per YS II.33

verses.tithi: Krishna Paksha Chaturdashi (until 12:06 PM EDT), then Krishna Paksha Amavasya
verses.nakshatra: Uttara Phalguni (until 11:49 AM EDT), then Hasta
sankhyaConcepts: Consciousness beyond duality: Supreme Person transcendental beyond fallible and infallible
Inner mechanism: eternal distinction between puruṣa and prakṛti; Lord sustains creation while remaining aloof

verses.tithi: Krishna Paksha Dwadashi (until 1:46 PM EDT), then Trayodashi — Pradosh Vrat observed
verses.nakshatra: Magha (until 12:10 PM EDT), then Purva Phalguni
sankhyaConcepts: puruṣa as consciousness pervading and energizing prakṛti
Lord entering creation (āviśya) and sustaining it (dhārayāmi)
splendor of celestial bodies as reflection of divine consciousness
discernment (viveka) and devotion (bhakti) turning perception into remembrance

verses.tithi: Krishna Paksha Ekadashi (until 3:04 PM EDT), then Daśamī — Indira Ekadashi observed
verses.nakshatra: Magha (until 12:47 PM EDT), then Purva Phalguni
sankhyaConcepts: puruṣa as sustaining consciousness entering planets (āviśya)
prakṛti energized by divine ojas (ojasā)
Lord's becoming moon (somo bhūtvā) to nourish vegetation
rasātmakaḥ as essence-bearing divine vitality in food
sanātanaḥ as eternal unchanging sustaining principle
